recordFindings.abstractOnly: 2017March07 predicted Orcus occultation reconstructed as Vanth occulting two stars; follow-up speckle imaging reveals double star. Two single chords291±125/434.4±2.4km plus nearby non-detection yield443±10km assuming sphere. Not measured global axes or registered shape. Atmospheric1–4microbar3sigma and ring optical-depth limits are conditional search constraints, not proof of absolute absence.
